### 4. Figures
Delivery package price = 6280.00 + 3570.00 = **9850.00** (matches price list 59400).

**A. Enrollment deposit** (maternity enrollment schedule (b)–(c); package % 25):
- Award base: covering award, discount 40 → figured on 9850.00 × 0.60 = 5910.00 [tier figure read from tier name; FAP KB unpublished — conditional].
- Days to delivery: 2026-10-20→2026-12-01 = 42 → 31–60 → percentage set at 50 (replaces 25).
- Enrollment-timing points: 2026-07-30→2026-12-01 = 124 lead days → 112–167 → +5.
- Late-enrollment-deposit points: 2026-07-30→2026-10-20 = 82 days → ≥60 → +10.
- Missed-appointment points: 1 fee (2026-04-14) inside 12 whole months → +5.
- Percentage = 50 + 20 = 70. Deposit = 5910.00 × 0.70 = **4137.00**.
- Fall-back: 9850.00 × 25% = **2462.50** — differs.

**B. Pre-delivery balance** (pre-delivery sheet "The balance" / "Figuring it"):
- Price owed before delivery (FAP price doc): 9850.00 × 0.60 = 5910.00; less deposits held 4137.00 → 1773.00.
- Prior cesarean: latest 59514 dated 2022-03-14 on an account with net charges 17900.00 > 0; whole months to 2026-10-20 = 55 → 18–59 → one half of 2850.00 = +1425.00.
- Early-payment credit: 42 days to delivery → 35–59 → 1% × 9850.00 = −98.50.
- Pay-in-full credit: latest initial deposit collection posted today → 0 days → 1.5% × 9850.00 = −147.75.
- Balance = 1773.00 + 1425.00 − 98.50 − 147.75 = **2951.75**.
- Fall-back: 9850.00 − 2462.50 = 7387.50 (no factor anywhere); 9850.00 − 4137.00 = 5713.00 (factored deposit only) — both differ.

Factor findability: approved case / "Charity Discount" → maternity FAP docs (title names "Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care)"); cpt 59514 / "Inpatient Admission Account" → "Prior Cesarean Delivery and the Maternity Pre-Delivery Balance" (names procedure code 59514, Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)); visit_fee_assessed → maternity missed-appointment doc; scheduling_date / scheduled_service_date / variant_name → days-to-delivery, enrollment-timing, late-enrollment, early-payment, pay-in-full docs (titles name the Maternity & Delivery package).
